title: Value Compass Benchmarks: A Comprehensive, Generative and Self-Evolving Platform for LLMs’ Value Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures alignment with a set of universal and moral values, some of which are explicitly linked to religion. Specifically, it evaluates the 'Tradition' value (respect for and acceptance of customs and ideas from traditional culture or religion) from Schwartz's Theory of Basic Values, and the 'Sanctity/Degradation' foundation (notions of striving to live in an elevated, noble way, often found in religious narratives) from Moral Foundation Theory.
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. It establishes a framework capable of measuring values such as 'Tradition' and 'Sanctity', which are derived from or associated with religious contexts, but it does not provide an analysis of how different LLMs perform on these specific value dimensions.
